raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Flux2 packs Q, K, and V in one projection and then `chunk`s them. Those K/V tensors are views, so they are not contiguous. With `--num-gpus 2` and sequence parallel left on its default, SGLang selects `kv_gather_degree=2`. The full-sequence gather then calls `all_gather_into_tensor` on that view. PyTorch's NCCL process group (`check_gpu_single_tensor`) rejects it with `ValueError: Tensors must be contiguous` before the collective runs. The same check is in the CUDA build, so NVIDIA hits it on this path too. The prefix and suffix branches already called `.contiguous()`. The unsliced branch did not, and that is the branch Flux2 takes.

## Modifications

- `USPAttention._gather_sharded_sequence` materializes the unsliced K/V tensor with `.contiguous()` before `sequence_model_parallel_all_gather`.
- `GroupCoordinator.all_gather` does the same immediately before `all_gather_into_tensor`, so any other non-contiguous caller of that collective meets the NCCL/RCCL requirement. An already-contiguous tensor is returned unchanged.
- `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_sp_kv_gather_contiguous.py` builds a K tensor with `chunk`, asserts it is not contiguous, and asserts the tensor passed into the gather is contiguous and equal to the original view. CPU CI: `base-a-test-cpu`.

## Accuracy Tests

Same prompt, seed 42, 720p, 50 steps, `torch.compile` on. The 1-GPU image is `20261012-055625`. The 2-GPU kv-gather image after this fix is `20261012-071319`. Both are 1280x720. The broken run saved no image, so this is 1-GPU versus 2-GPU sequence parallel, not a before/after of the copy. The unit test checks that `.contiguous()` keeps the same values as the view.

| metric | value |
| --- | --- |
| mean abs (0-255) | 2.46 |
| RMSE | 8.42 |
| max abs | 255 |
| PSNR | 29.6 dB |
| pixels with abs diff > 8 | 8.6% |

## Benchmarking and Profiling

MI355, Flux2-dev, 720p, 50 steps, seed 42, `torch.compile` on. The 2-GPU kv-gather run aborted before the fix, so it has no latency.

| config | result | denoising | per step |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 GPU | completed | 24.79 s | 0.409 s |
| 2 GPU kv-gather, before | abort: `Tensors must be contiguous` | — | — |
| 2 GPU kv-gather, after | image saved | 20.19 s | 0.351 s |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the PR flow. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`, `/tag-and-rerun-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls to merge.

files.patch:
@@ -1526,10 +1526,9 @@ def _gather_sharded_sequence(
                 "Replicated prefix and suffix cannot be used at the same time."
             )
 
-        # slicing along dim 1 keeps the original row stride, so the shard is
-        # contiguous only while the batch dim is 1; all_gather_into_tensor
-        # requires a contiguous input, so materialize the shard before the
-        # collective
+        # A dim-1 slice keeps the original row stride, and Flux2 K/V are views
+        # from qkv.chunk, so neither form is contiguous. all_gather_into_tensor
+        # rejects a non-contiguous input, so materialize before the collective.
         if num_replicated_prefix:
             replicated = tensor[:, :num_replicated_prefix]
             sharded = tensor[:, num_replicated_prefix:].contiguous()
@@ -1542,7 +1541,7 @@ def _gather_sharded_sequence(
             gathered = sequence_model_parallel_all_gather(sharded, dim=1)
             return torch.cat([gathered, replicated], dim=1)
 
-        return sequence_model_parallel_all_gather(tensor, dim=1)
+        return sequence_model_parallel_all_gather(tensor.contiguous(), dim=1)
 
     def _forward_with_kv_gather(
         self,

@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+"""Sequence-parallel K/V gather must materialize non-contiguous views.
+
+Flux2 packs Q, K, and V with one projection and then ``chunk``s them. That
+view is not contiguous, and ``all_gather_into_tensor`` rejects it.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.layer import USPAttention
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+class TestSequenceParallelKvGatherContiguous(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_noncontiguous_kv_chunk_is_materialized_before_all_gather(self):
+        packed = torch.randn(2, 8, 12)
+        key = packed.chunk(3, dim=-1)[1]
+        self.assertFalse(key.is_contiguous())
+
+        captured = {}
+
+        def fake_all_gather(tensor, dim=-1):
+            captured["tensor"] = tensor
+            captured["dim"] = dim
+            return tensor
+
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.layer.sequence_model_parallel_all_gather",
+            fake_all_gather,
+        ):
+            gathered = USPAttention._gather_sharded_sequence(key)
+
+        self.assertEqual(captured["dim"], 1)
+        self.assertTrue(captured["tensor"].is_contiguous())
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(captured["tensor"], key))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(gathered, key))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
